issues.title: Currency cents rendered three different ways
issues.detail: The same dollarDisplay component shows cents as superscript on list balances ($226,767.82), as plain inline cents for "Current" balances and the credit Total Balance ($12,505.87), and drops cents entirely in SAFE totals ($10,011,000), the payment success copy ("Your payment of $500") and limits ("$5K"). The credit card balance is superscripted in the Accounts list but not on its own detail page. The credit card header rounds "$21,249 available" while Show details lists "Available to spend $21,248.88", and the venture debt confirmation drops cents and adds a currency code ("$250,000 USD") right after a review screen showing "$250,000.00".
issues.evidence: Re-measured 2026-09-24 at 2x: Accounts row $226,767.82 wraps ".82" in <span class="_superscript_1of3b_35" style="wght 500">; credit Total Balance is a plain <SPAN> "$12,505.87" 28px/380 Arcadia Display; SAFE total "$10,011,000" <SPAN> 19px/400 Arcadia Text vs table "$1,000.00" 15px/400; credit page text "$21,249 available" vs "$21,248.88" in the details panel.

issues.title: Dates use at least six formats across the area
issues.detail: Payment and activity dates switch between "Sep 24" (activity tables), "October 1" (Upcoming payments), "Sep 10, 2026" (repayment schedule), "Oct 01" with a zero-padded day (Venture Debt next payment), "Oct 5, 2026" (interest-only end), "Jan 1 2027" with no comma (projected payments), "October 22" (autopay modal), "Oct 22" (credit autopay pill) and "September 24-25, 2026" (transfer success). On Working Capital the two formats sit side by side and are also styled differently.
issues.evidence: Working Capital: Upcoming "October 1" <SPAN> 15px/400 rgb(195,195,204); Activity "Sep 24" <TD> 14px/400 rgb(255,255,255). Venture debt page text "Next payment Oct 01" and "Interest only ends Oct 5, 2026"; projected payments rows "Oct 1" and "Jan 1 2027".

issues.title: Time ranges written with en dash, hyphen and "to"
issues.detail: Settlement windows are written "1–2 business days" (en dash) and "Appears in 1 to 5 business days" on the same Add funds page, "0-1 business days" (hyphen) and "1 to 2 days" on Edit portfolio, and "September 24-25, 2026" (hyphen) on the transfer success screen. Treasury's net return modal reads "Net return for August 1-31" (hyphen) and the venture debt confirmation says "within 1–3 business days" (en dash).
issues.evidence: Strings read from DOM text: "Arrives in 1–2 business days." / "Appears in 1 to 5 business days." (add-funds); "take effect in 0-1 business days" / "1 to 2 days" (portfolio edit); "between September 24-25, 2026." (success). Net return modal: "Net return for August 1-31"; VD success: "funds should arrive in your account within 1–3 business days".

issues.title: Back/cancel action has five different labels
issues.detail: The dismiss-or-previous action is "Cancel" (Create account, Unlink, Edit recurring autopay, custom statement, limit increase), "Back" (auto transfer rule forms opened from the picker, which say "Cancel" when opened from an empty-state card; Transfer funds; Share statement), "Go back" (credit payment, Edit autopay accounts, SAFE steps, venture debt draw), "Go Back" in Title Case (Edit portfolio) and "‹ Edit" (credit payment review). The Remove shared document links dialog even relabels its only button from "Close" to "Cancel" once a row is ticked.
issues.evidence: Accessible button names from snapshots on 2026-09-24: target balance rule "Back"/"Next"; pay credit "Go back"/"Review" then "Edit"/"Confirm payment"; Edit autopay accounts "Go back"/"Save"; recurring autopay "Cancel"/"Save"; limit increase "Cancel"/"Request Increase"; share sheet "Back"/"Share via email"; shared links dialog "Close" → "Cancel".

issues.title: Secondary modal buttons use two visual styles
issues.detail: The Cancel button in the Create account modal is a ghost button with no fill, while Cancel in the Unlink modal and Back in the auto transfer rule review are filled tonal pills. Same role, same size, different treatment.
issues.evidence: Re-measured 2026-09-24: Create account Cancel <BUTTON> bg rgba(0,0,0,0), color rgb(221,221,229), radius 9999px, padding 8px 32px, height 40px. Unlink Cancel, limit increase Cancel and Disbursement agreement Cancel: bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), same color, radius, padding and 40px height.

issues.title: Modal titles use two type scales
issues.detail: Most modal titles (Create account, Make a credit payment, Autopay settings) are small Arcadia Text headings, but the Link bank account modal uses a 28px Arcadia Display title, the size used for page balances.
issues.evidence: Create account <H2> 19px/400 Arcadia Text, line-height 28px (re-measured); How your IO limit works and Disbursement Agreement <H2> 19px/400. Link bank "What type of account is Iron Bank Checking 1?": SPAN 28px/380 Arcadia Display, line-height 36px.

issues.title: Modal heading levels are arbitrary
issues.detail: Modal titles are exposed as h1 (Autopay settings, Edit autopay accounts), h2 (Create account, Create a new auto transfer rule, Distribute funds across accounts, How your IO limit works) and h3 (Maintain a target account balance), so two sibling rule forms opened from the same picker sit at different levels. The share-statement sheet has no heading at all.
issues.evidence: Snapshots 2026-09-24: heading "Autopay settings" [level=1], "Edit autopay accounts" [level=1], "Create a new auto transfer rule" [level=2], "Distribute funds across accounts" [level=2], "Maintain a target account balance" [level=3]; share dialog: querySelector("h1,h2,h3") === null.

issues.title: Title Case and sentence case mixed for the same labels
issues.detail: The same labels change case between places: the Documents menu says "Bank Letters" / "Wire Details" but the Documents sub-nav says "Bank letters" / "Wire details"; Treasury shows "Net yield" in the summary card and "Net Yield" in the Portfolio tab; "Ending Balance" (Upcoming payments) vs "Ending balance" (schedule); "Valuation cap" (SAFE form) vs "Valuation Cap" (SAFE drawer); "Post-money" (dropdown) vs "Post-Money" (list and review); toast "Account Linked" vs "Account nickname updated"; "Venture Debt Loan Repayment" vs "Working capital loan payment". Other Title Case outliers: "Link Credit account", "View Account", "Total Balance", "Learn More About SAFE Types", "Explore Options". More outliers in the new flows: the credit page pill says "Linked Accounts" while the tab says "Linked accounts"; the limit increase modal uses "Current Limit", "Requested Amount" and "Request Increase"; Add funds has "Wire Instructions" and "View More Details"; the venture debt success page offers "Make Another Request" where Treasury says "Make another transfer"; status badges read "Draw Request Pending" next to "Up to date".
issues.evidence: Re-checked 2026-09-24: Treasury summary "Net yield" vs Portfolio tab "Net Yield"; Working Capital column "Ending Balance"; SAFE option "Post-money" vs list "Post-Money"; buttons "Request Increase" <BUTTON> and "Make Another Request" <A> 16px/360 rgb(141,164,245); label "Requested Amount" <LABEL> 13px; badge text "Up to date" <SPAN> 12px rgb(119,197,153).

issues.title: Same setting named differently
issues.detail: Auto transfer rules are "auto transfer rule" everywhere except the Edit autopay accounts modal ("add an auto-transfer rule."). The fallback account is "Backup autopay account (recommended)" for the credit card but "Back up autopay account" for the working capital loan. The same checking account is "Ops / Payroll" in most places, "Mercury Checking ••1038" in Financing activity, and Treasury activity transfers name a "Primary Checking" account that does not exist in the account list. Rule types change names between the picker and the form: "Distribute funds out" opens "Distribute funds across accounts", "Send recurring transfers" opens "Schedule recurring transfers" and "Maintain a target balance" opens "Maintain a target account balance". The "Manage shared documents" link opens a dialog titled "Remove shared document links".
issues.evidence: Strings re-checked 2026-09-24: link "add an auto-transfer rule."; "Backup autopay account (recommended)"; Working Capital activity "Mercury Checking ••1038"; Treasury activity "Transfer from Primary Checking"; picker buttons "Distribute funds out", "Send recurring transfers", "Maintain a target balance" vs headings "Distribute funds across accounts", "Maintain a target account balance"; dialog "Remove shared document links".

issues.title: Authorization disclaimers are formatted differently in each flow
issues.detail: Consent lines quote the button three ways: 'Create rule,' (straight single quotes), “Transfer,” (curly double quotes) and Confirm Payment (no quotes, Title Case, while the button says "Confirm payment"). Credit autopay modals say "By clicking Save, you" and "By clicking Save you". The line sits above the buttons in rule review and payment review, and below them in the autopay modals and Review transfer.
issues.evidence: Strings 2026-09-24: "By clicking 'Create rule,' I authorize…"; "By clicking “Transfer,” I authorize…"; "By clicking Confirm Payment, I authorize Mercury…" (button reads "Confirm payment"); recurring autopay "By clicking Save, you authorize…" vs threshold "By clicking Save you authorize…".

issues.title: Destructive actions confirmed inconsistently
issues.detail: Remove rule deletes an auto transfer rule immediately and only shows a toast, while Unlink account asks "Do you want to unlink this account?" with a destructive "Yes, unlink" button. Saving loan autopay closes the modal without any toast, while other saves (rule created, nickname updated, portfolio updated) do show one.
issues.evidence: Remove rule → toast "Auto transfer rule removed" with no intermediate dialog. Unlink dialog "Yes, unlink": color rgb(252,146,180), bg rgba(252,146,180,0.2). Loan autopay Confirm → no [role=status]/toast text in DOM afterwards.

issues.title: Credit autopay is a rule in one tab and missing from the other
issues.detail: The Mercury accounts list shows "Autopay from Ops / Payroll, Every 22nd of the month or if <80% of limit left" in the Auto transfer rules column, but the Auto transfer rules tab shows the empty state "Create rules that move money between your bank accounts." with template cards.
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: /accounts row text "Autopay from Ops / Payroll\nEvery 22nd of the month or if <80% of limit left"; /accounts#auto-transfers shows "Create rules that move money between your bank accounts." and no "You have N auto transfer rule" text.

issues.title: Account numbers masked with different dot counts, or not at all
issues.detail: Masked numbers show six dots on checking ("••••••1038"), five on savings ("•••••7658") and two in lists ("Checking ••1038"). The Review transfer screen shows the Treasury account number in full ("Treasury 3713286"). Routing numbers for two accounts at the same bank also differ (132456789 vs 123456789).
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: checking "••••••1038" <DIV> 15px/400, routing "132456789"; savings "•••••7658" <DIV> 15px/400, routing "123456789", both Column N.A.; review text "Treasury 3713286".

issues.title: Treasury Documents ignores its account filter
issues.detail: Documents on checking opens Statements filtered to that account (Accounts: "Ops / Payroll"). Documents on Treasury links to ?accountIds=party-treasury-id-0, but the page shows "8 selected" and lists every account, including Credit, AP, AR and Sweep summary.
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: Treasury Documents <A href="/settings/documents/statements?accountIds=party-treasury-id-0"> → Accounts combobox shows "8 selected", rows Credit, Treasury, Ops / Payroll, AP, AR, Sweep summary; checking link ?accountIds=mercurybankid2 → combobox "Ops / Payroll".

issues.title: "Documents" is a dropdown on one account page and a link on another
issues.detail: On checking and savings detail, Documents is a chevron dropdown (Statements / Bank Letters / Wire Details). On Treasury it is a link that navigates straight to Statements, rendered at a larger 16px with the icon on the other side.
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: checking Documents <BUTTON> 13.33px/360, padding 4px 12px 4px 16px, height 32px, opens menu; Treasury Documents <A> 16px/360, padding 4px 16px 4px 12px, height 32px.

issues.title: Plus icon placed after the label on Create new SAFE
issues.detail: "Create new SAFE +" puts the plus icon after the label, while every other create/add action in the area puts it before ("+ Create rule", "+ Deposit", "+ Order Checkbook", "+ Create account").
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: Create new SAFE <a class="_button_r6b2u_20 _small_r6b2u_72 _primary_r6b2u_104"> children DIV, svg (icon last), padding 4px 12px 4px 16px; Deposit children svg, path, DIV (icon first); Create rule padding 4px 16px 4px 12px.

issues.title: Sending a SAFE opens the wrong record
issues.detail: After Send SAFE, the toast reads "SAFE sent to Arthur Rock", but the list still shows 3 SAFEs with unchanged totals, and the detail drawer that opens shows Logan Roy's $1,000 SAFE. Company details also label the company "Acme Inc." with state "CA", while other flows authorize for "Mercury Demo, Incorporated".
issues.evidence: URL /capital/safe?safeRequest=1; summary still "SAFEs 3", "Total $10,011,000"; drawer header "Logan Roy logan@roy.co"; company details text "Company legal name Acme Inc." / "State of incorporation CA".

issues.title: Removing a shared link says "Removed 1 statements"
issues.detail: Removing access for one recipient link that covered 4 documents shows the toast "Removed 1 statements": wrong plural, and it counts links as statements. The button that triggers it says "Remove access to 1 document link".
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: row "rotem@gmail.com 4 documents shared" ticked; button "Remove access to 1 document link" (bg rgba(252,146,180,0.2), color rgb(252,146,180)); toast text "Removed 1 statements".

issues.title: "IO" missing from the limit explainer title
issues.detail: The How limits work dialog title is built as "How your IO limit works". The IO span renders as an empty gap in both 2x captures, so the title reads "How your limit works". Everywhere else ("Mercury IO", "IO Credit Limit works") IO is plain Arcadia text.
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: H2 19px/400 innerHTML "How your IO limit works"; FontFace "IO" status loaded, span 24.1×19px, color rgb(244,245,249), no visible glyphs in 92-credit-how-limits.png.

issues.title: Credit activity period control mislabels what it shows
issues.detail: On load the credit card activity table lists rows dated Sep 30 although today is Sep 24. Clicking "Last Month" switches the rows to Aug 30, but the heading still says "This month" (with this month's $157.5K cashback / $10.5M spent summary) and the control still reads "Last Month", so nothing tells you which month you are looking at.
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24 page text before click: date cells "Sep 30"; after click: "Aug 30" ×10, "Sep 30" ×0, heading "This month" present, control text "Last Month" unchanged, no "This Month" label.

issues.title: Acknowledge buttons switch between primary and secondary
issues.detail: Info dialogs that only need acknowledging use a primary blue button ("Got it" in How limits work, "Done" after a limit request, "Close" in Projected payments) but a grey tonal one in the Treasury net return dialog ("Done").
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: "Got it" <BUTTON> bg rgb(82,102,235) color rgb(255,255,255) h 40px; net return "Done" <BUTTON> bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12) color rgb(221,221,229) h 40px, both padding 8px 32px, 13.33px/360.

issues.title: Buttons in the same role come in three sizes
issues.detail: Dialog actions are 40px tall with 8px 32px padding in Create account, limit increase and Disbursement agreement, but 32px with 4px 16px padding in Remove shared document links. On the venture debt success page the primary "View loan details" uses a 16px label, while primary buttons elsewhere use 13.33px.
issues.evidence: 2026-09-24: Create account "Create account" <BUTTON> 13.33px/360, padding 8px 32px, height 40px; "Agree" same; shared links "Cancel" / "Remove access to 1 document link" <BUTTON> 13.33px/360, padding 4px 16px, height 32px; "View loan details" <A> 16px/360, padding 8px 32px, height 40px.

issues.detail:
The four rule template cards on Accounts > Auto transfer rules each contain an invisible '.' element after the label, so the button's accessible name is 'Distribute funds across accounts .' (space, then period). Screen readers read the stray period; sighted users see nothing. The period sits in a
inside a

, which is also invalid HTML.

DOM (2026-09-25) on /accounts#auto-transfers: ; the
has opacity 0, width 0px, no aria-hidden. Accessibility tree: button "Distribute funds across accounts .", button "Maintain a target account balance ." (same for 'Schedule recurring transfers .' and 'Redirect incoming funds .').
